claims.claim: Toyota Camry engine (5x old model) direct with guarantee
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a generic car engine bay/engine assembly with alternator and belts/pulleys; make/model/variant and any guarantee are not readable or shown.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/variant may not be a Toyota Camry unit (compatibility risk).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine code) and/or VIN/part number label, plus a shot showing the engine model markings near the cylinder block.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine assembly with compatibility not confirmed.

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (may not start, may have internal wear).
risks.proof: Short video clip of the engine starting and idling (cold start if possible), showing stable RPM and no abnormal smoke/noise.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: for parts/repair).

risks.risk: Possible head gasket/overheating or compression issues not visible in the engine-bay close-up.
risks.proof: Compression test results (numbers) and/or cooling system pressure test screenshot/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential head-gasket/overheating risk (worst-case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Timing system condition (timing chain/belt, tensioner) unknown; could be worn or mis-timed.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing timing cover area (or timing marks) and/or receipt showing recent timing service.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming timing condition unknown (worst-case: timing service/engine rebuild needed).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect components (turbo, injectors, sensors, starter, alternator, wiring harness) or incomplete assembly.
risks.proof: Inventory photo list: show all major accessories and sensors installed, including starter, alternator, fuel rail/injectors, and any turbo/MAF/ECU-related parts if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly incomplete (worst-case: missing parts to be sourced).

risks.risk: Fault codes/ECU issues not captured; may fail after installation.
risks.proof: OBD scan screenshot showing stored/pending codes (or a diagnostic report) and ECU part number photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown electrical/ECU health (worst-case: diagnostic/repairs required).

risks.risk: Physical damage not captured (cracks, bent mounts, stripped threads, leaks).
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of cylinder head, block casting areas, mounting points, and underside for cracks/leaks; plus a leak test video (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential damage risk (worst-case: parts replacement/repair).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped markings on the cylinder block (to confirm Toyota Camry compatibility).
Video of the engine starting and idling (showing smoke level, noise, and stable RPM).
Compression test results (and/or cylinder leak-down) with numbers.
Photos showing timing system condition (timing cover area) or proof of recent timing service.
Inventory photos of all included components (starter, alternator, sensors, injectors/fuel rail, wiring harness, and any turbo/MAF/ECU parts if applicable).
OBD scan screenshot showing fault codes (stored/pending) and ECU part number photo.
Photos of mounting points and any visible cracks/leaks; ideally a leak test or underside inspection clip.
response.reason: The witness confirms only a generic engine assembly; the claimed Toyota Camry identity and working condition are not verifiable from the provided report. Without proof of engine code/compatibility and whether it runs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
